checks.name: mobile_inspections_inspection_type_check
checks.expression: (inspection_type = ANY (ARRAY['Open home'::text, 'Private viewing'::text, 'Routine inspection'::text, 'Entry condition'::text, 'Exit condition'::text]))

checks.name: profile_document_review_events_rejection_reason_check
checks.expression: ((review_status <> 'REJECTED'::"ProfileDocumentReviewStatus") OR (NULLIF(TRIM(BOTH FROM COALESCE(rejection_reason, ''::text)), ''::text) IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: properties_nonnegative_room_counts_check
checks.expression: (((bedrooms IS NULL) OR (bedrooms >= 0)) AND ((bathrooms IS NULL) OR (bathrooms >= 0)) AND ((parking_spaces IS NULL) OR (parking_spaces >= 0)))

checks.name: properties_valid_coordinates_check
checks.expression: (((latitude IS NULL) OR ((latitude >= ('-90'::integer)::numeric) AND (latitude <= (90)::numeric))) AND ((longitude IS NULL) OR ((longitude >= ('-180'::integer)::numeric) AND (longitude <= (180)::numeric))))

unique.name: property_media_storage_object_idx
unique.where: ((storage_bucket IS NOT NULL) AND (storage_path IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: payment_reference_requires_provider
checks.expression: ((provider_payment_id IS NULL) OR (provider IS NOT NULL))

checks.name: tenant_profiles_budget_range_check
checks.expression: ((budget_min IS NULL) OR (budget_max IS NULL) OR (budget_min <= budget_max))
